name: reward-03-single-recipient
exercises: single-recipient base case: one leaf at leaf_index 0; reward_root == leaf_hash(sole leaf) (no interior node). Merkle base case for the reward tree.
leaf_hash_formula: SHA-256(0x00 || 'CRP:reward:v1' || recipient(32) || amount_base_units(u64 BE) || leaf_index(u64 BE))
ordering: aggregate Σ over cohorts per recipient; DROP zero-sum recipients; rank ascending by recipient(BE32, unique key) then amount_base_units; leaf_index = 0-based rank; leaves placed by leaf_index contiguous from 0
